description:
Protocol version 4 replaced the shared addendum schema in place, so the version-2 and version-3 schemas survive only inside committed receipt snapshots and a frozen version-3 addendum no longer validates against the shared path.

## Background

`dev/active/f547c394/addendum.schema.json` is the schema every family addendum validates against, and its `schema` and `version` constants name the protocol version it describes. The version-1 schema is preserved beside it as `addendum-v1.schema.json`. The version-4 amendment edited the shared file rather than adding a version-4 sibling, so the version-2 and version-3 schemas exist only as `inputs/` snapshots inside the receipts whose campaigns pinned them. Validating a frozen version-3 addendum against the shared path fails on the two const constraints, which forced a closed survey to validate against the snapshot its receipt pins instead of the shared schema.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every protocol version that a committed receipt pins has a committed schema under `dev/active/f547c394/` whose digest equals the snapshot digest the receipt records.
- [hard] REQ-02: The shared schema path validates the current protocol version, and a frozen addendum of any earlier version validates against the committed schema of the version it names, from a fresh checkout.
- [hard] REQ-03: A committed check fails when a receipt pins an addendum schema whose digest matches no committed schema file.
- [hard] REQ-04: No receipt, snapshot byte, frozen addendum or committed summary changes.

## Notes

Surfaced while repairing the DVB-T2 interleaving family, whose frozen version-3 addendum stopped validating after the version-4 amendment landed.
title: Version the addendum schema alongside its predecessors
